detail: Chain reset. Every record this log previously held asserted the RETIRED, refuted uncounted purpose="verify" authorization class: verify-split took a session it never needed and recorded it as uncounted, and that class was removed because an uncounted session able to read the salt regenerates the entire sealed set. No genuine sealed session has ever occurred, so the first real one must not hash-chain onto a history of a mechanism that no longer exists and never should have. The chain therefore starts here, with prev_sha256 = null, and this record's digest is anchored in data/sealed_log_anchor.json.
